# OmniMem

> OmniMem is self-hosted AI memory served over MCP (Model Context Protocol): it gives AI agents persistent semantic memory across sessions, projects, and machines. One app for macOS, Windows and Linux desktops, or one binary on a server. Open source, MIT licensed, free forever.

OmniMem stores episodic memories, project context, knowledge articles, preferences, and compiled skills in a single SQLite file, with exact vector search in memory and local ONNX embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, no GPU, no API calls). It features a memory lifecycle (active → deprioritised → archived → deleted), an abandoned-approach graveyard, experience scoring, contradiction detection, semantic deduplication, a propose-and-accept skill compiler, RSS knowledge ingestion, and Claude Code hooks that brief every session and stop known dead ends before they run. It works with any MCP-capable agent: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, claude.ai, Codex, OpenCode, Kiro, GitHub Copilot, GitLab Duo, and Cursor.

## Docs

- [Source repository](https://code.squarecows.com/ric/omnimem): full README, manual, and deployment guides
- [Latest release](https://code.squarecows.com/ric/omnimem/releases/latest): the DMG (macOS 13.4+, Apple silicon), MSI (Windows 10 and 11), Flatpak (Linux desktop), .deb and .rpm (Linux servers)
- [Install](https://omnimem.org/#quickstart): download the app, or `docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8765:8765 -v omnimem-data:/data -e MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=<token> richarvey/omnimem`
- [Connect Claude Code](https://omnimem.org/#quickstart): `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user omnimem http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp`

## Key facts

- OmniMem 7 is one Rust binary: the MCP server (streamable HTTP at /mcp, bearer token or OAuth 2.1), the RSS scheduler and the enrichment worker in one process, with a tray app whose settings window replaces the old web UI
- 48 MCP tools; over HTTP it serves only /mcp, the OAuth routes and /healthz
- An Anthropic API key is optional: it turns on Claude Haiku for fact extraction, query expansion, deeper contradiction checks and RSS summaries. Add it on the settings window's Configuration page (kept in the OS keychain) or as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on a server. Embeddings stay local either way
- Moving from 6.x: back up with dump_to_file() and import the file; every memory is re-embedded from its text
- Self-hosted and MIT licensed, with a managed cloud version coming soon; no telemetry to third parties
